import CategoryTheory.Limits.Types
import CategoryTheory.Functor
import CategoryTheory.UnivLE

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target (w : CategoryTheory.uliftFunctor.{u, v}.EssSurj) : UnivLE.{max u v, v} := by
  let F := CategoryTheory.uliftFunctor.{u, v}
  let h_ess_surj := w

  have h_preserves_colimits : PreservesColimitsOfSize (max u v) F :=
    CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.instPreservesColimitsOfSizeUliftFunctor.{v, u}

  have h_preserves_limits : PreservesLimitsOfSize (max u v) F :=
    CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.instPreservesLimitsOfSizeUliftFunctor.{v, u}

  let C := ULift.{v, u}
  let h_category : Category.{max u v, v} C := infer_instance
  let h_univle_max : UnivLE.{max u v, v} :=
    @CategoryTheory.AB5StarOfSize_of_univLE _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      C
      h_category
      h_preserves_colimits
      h_preserves_limits
      (infer_instance : UnivLE.{max u v, v})
      (infer_instance : UnivLE.{max u v, max u v})
      (infer_instance : CategoryTheory.AB5StarOfSize.{max u v, max u v, v, u} C)

  exact h_univle_max
